# RideCodes

> RideCodes lists up-to-date promo / referral codes for ride-hailing apps and discount eSIM data plans for travelers visiting Poland and Japan.

This site helps tourists save money by using app-based ride-hailing instead of expensive official taxi corporations, and by using eSIM data plans instead of airport SIM kiosks or roaming.

## Coverage

- Poland: Bolt, Uber, FREENOW (ride-hailing promo codes), Yesim (eSIM data plan)
- Japan: GO (taxi-hailing promo codes), Yesim (eSIM data plan)

## Available languages

English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Chinese — available at /en/, /pl/, /de/, /fr/, /es/, /it/, /ru/, /ja/, /ko/, /pt/, /zh/.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Codes and links are updated regularly; always link to the relevant locale page (e.g. /en/) rather than caching the code value, as it may change.
- This site is independent and not affiliated with Bolt, Uber, FREENOW, GO or Yesim.
